title: Adam and AdamW step
summary: One Adam update with bias correction and a step counter that starts at 1, plus AdamW decoupled weight decay, as a pure function of the state.

mutants.no_bias_correction: Uses m and v directly and skips the division by 1 minus beta to the t.
mutants.step_off_by_one: Uses t plus 1 in the bias correction, so the first step acts as step 2.
mutants.eps_inside_sqrt: Puts epsilon inside the square root, so tiny gradients give a much smaller step.
mutants.coupled_weight_decay: Adds weight_decay times params to the gradient, which is L2 in Adam and not AdamW.
mutants.in_place_state: Updates the old state arrays with *= and +=, so the caller's m and v change.
